                item['description'],
                item['quantity'],

                item['line_amount']

        printed_total = Decimal(invoice_data['total'])

        difference = computed_total - printed_total
        status = 'matched' if difference == 0 else 'discrepancy'

            f"{subtotal:.2f}",
            invoice_data['tax'],

            f"{computed_total:.2f}",
            f"{difference:.2f}",
            status
        ])

print("CSV files created successfully")
print("\nReconciliation Summary:")
for invoice_id, invoice_data in invoices.items():
